title: Extend a design system without flattening it
summary: Continue a supplied component system by promoting one repeated need, pruning one premature abstraction, and protecting one behavior-heavy exception.
originNote: Combines a standard design-system continuation task with history-derived corrections about extraction boundaries and real-component specimens.

setup.instructions: Mount the synthetic component system and product brief as editable source. Build a self-contained styleguide that imports the source modules it demonstrates; do not copy their markup into lookalike specimens.

turns.content: Read fixtures/brief.json and the supplied files in src/. Extend this small component system for the three product contexts in the brief, then build index.html, styleguide.js, and styles.css as a responsive styleguide. The styleguide must import and render the real source components rather than recreating specimen-only copies. Decide what repeated need deserves one new shared primitive or variant, what existing abstraction is premature and should be removed, and what behavior-heavy or unique element should remain local to its feature. Keep the established token roles and visual hierarchy unless the evidence in the supplied contexts warrants a surgical change. Include a short visible decision ledger using data-system-decision values promote, prune, and keep-local.

Revise the result around these boundaries: promote the repeated status treatment into one shared StatusBadge primitive or warranted existing-component variant; prune the single-use LabeledValue abstraction and return that composition to local markup; keep SignalArc in src/signal-panel.js as a behavior-heavy feature component rather than generalizing its radial behavior into the visual system. Preserve working imports and update the real source components and styleguide together.

checks.description: The styleguide imports real components and the promote, prune, and keep-local decisions are reflected in source.
Review whether the extension feels native to the supplied system without making its shared layer absorb the unique radial behavior.
